summary: No mathematical errors or gaps were found. Small-support and boundary cases, lower-rank concentration, and escaping-support limits do not refute the claim. The proof correctly establishes tightness after unimodular normalization, obtains a finite complete full-rank log-affine limit, applies the accepted equality characterization with matching capacity normalization, and excludes the resulting square limit by the fixed-box extension argument. All uses of the accepted predecessor satisfy its hypotheses, including conditional supports and boundary centers. The infimum argument establishes one absolute constant uniformly over supports and tilts.
